onboarding.privacy.title: Just this phone
onboarding.privacy.body: SmileProc keeps your check-ins on this phone. There is no account and no server. They are not in backups or phone-to-phone transfer, so export a copy if you want to keep them.
onboarding.location.title: Location, if you want
onboarding.location.body: A check-in can remember where you were, so places can show up in your week. You can skip this, and you can turn it off later.
onboarding.reminders.title: A gentle nudge
onboarding.reminders.body: Pick the times you want a reminder. The notification only asks how you are. It never shows a mood.
onboarding.widget.title: Log in one tap
onboarding.widget.ios: Add the SmileProc lock-screen widget. Three faces, and the tap saves immediately.
onboarding.widget.android: Add the SmileProc home-screen widget. You can also answer straight from the reminder, even on the lock screen.
onboarding.widget.lock: Require Face ID, Touch ID, or passcode to open SmileProc
onboarding.widget.androidLock: Require biometrics or your screen lock to open SmileProc
privacy.title: What's stored and where
privacy.body: Your check-ins, place names, and weekly cards stay on this phone. They are encrypted at rest. They are left out of backups and phone-to-phone transfer. If the phone is lost or erased, the history is gone unless you exported a copy. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you export a file or tap a support number.
privacy.exportHint: Export keeps a copy you can open on this phone or the other one.
export.title: Export
export.warning: If you forget this password, the export can't be opened.
import.title: Import
import.wrongPassword: That password didn't open the file.
deleteAll.title: Delete all data
deleteAll.body: This removes every check-in, place, and weekly card from this phone, along with the encryption key. It can't be undone.
lock.title: SmileProc is locked
recovery.title: This history can't be opened
recovery.body: The check-ins are still on this phone, but the key that opens them isn't. You can import an export, or start fresh. Starting fresh removes the locked data.

error.locationDenied: Location is off for SmileProc. You can turn it on in Settings, or keep logging without it.
error.notificationsDenied: Notifications are off, so reminders can't arrive. You can turn them on in Settings.
error.writeFailed: That check-in couldn't be saved. Try again after unlocking the phone.
debug.title: Debug
debug.spikeNotes: A1: after the phone has been unlocked once since boot, lock it and tap a reminder face. The check-in is in History after you unlock, and the lock screen only says SmileProc. A2: a reminder saves the last known location, or none. A3: the home-screen widget shows Saved for about 60 seconds and does not show which face. A4: leave a reminder overnight and note how many minutes late it was.
